children: Overview
US workwear retailer's fiscal Q2 sales fell 7.8% yr/yr
Net income, adjusted EPS for Q2 rose, helped by $16.3 mln tariff refunds
Company raised full-year adjusted EBITDA outlook, affirms sales guidance
Outlook
Company affirms fiscal 2026 net sales guidance of $540 mln to $560 mln
Duluth Holdings raises fiscal 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to $38 mln to $42 mln
Company maintains fiscal 2026 capital expenditures guidance at about $12 mln
Result Drivers
TARIFF REFUNDS - $16.3 mln in tariff refunds contributed to net income and gross margin expansion
INVENTORY DISCIPLINE - 15.5% reduction in inventory improved working capital
HIGHER PRICES, LOWER PROMOTIONS - Gross margin expansion driven by higher average unit retail prices from reduced promotional activity and improved product costs via direct to factory sourcing
